description:
Debut group single for the Nijigasaki High School Idol Club as part of the Love Live! PERFECT Dream Project. The music video for TOKIMEKI Runners, along with the opening movie for the Love Live! School idol festival ALL STARS, was released in the DVD/Blu-Ray release coinciding with the album.

Note: The song featured in this music video was also used as an insert song in the TV anime Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai 2.
